tokens.name: color-background
tokens.description: The background of the page.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.description: The background of a card, a table, a panel or a dialog, which sits on the page.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.description: The line between regions and around a card; decorative.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.description: The border of a control such as an input, a checkbox or a switch; it must be seen against the page, the surface and the fill of a field.

tokens.name: color-field
tokens.description: The fill of a text control, one step above the surface, so that the control is found without relying on its border alone.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.description: The colour of body text and headings.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.description: The colour of secondary text such as hints and captions.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.description: The colour of the main action and of a selected control.

tokens.name: color-accent-foreground
tokens.description: The colour of text and icons on the accent colour.

tokens.name: color-accent-subtle
tokens.description: A pale tint of the accent colour for a selected row or a badge.

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.description: The accent colour for text on the page or on a surface, such as a link.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.description: The colour of an action that destroys or cannot be undone.

tokens.name: color-danger-foreground
tokens.description: The colour of text and icons on the danger colour.

tokens.name: color-danger-subtle
tokens.description: The background of an alert that reports an error.

tokens.name: color-danger-text
tokens.description: The colour of the title of an error alert and of an error message.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.description: The colour that confirms that something worked.

tokens.name: color-success-foreground
tokens.description: The colour of text and icons on the success colour.

tokens.name: color-success-subtle
tokens.description: The background of an alert that reports success.

tokens.name: color-success-text
tokens.description: The colour of the title of a success alert.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.description: The colour that asks for care without reporting an error.

tokens.name: color-warning-foreground
tokens.description: The colour of text and icons on the warning colour.

tokens.name: color-warning-subtle
tokens.description: The background of an alert that warns.

tokens.name: color-warning-text
tokens.description: The colour of the title of a warning alert.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.description: The colour of neutral information that needs attention.

tokens.name: color-info-foreground
tokens.description: The colour of text and icons on the info colour.

tokens.name: color-info-subtle
tokens.description: The background of an alert that informs.

tokens.name: color-info-text
tokens.description: The colour of the title of an information alert.

tokens.name: color-focus-ring
tokens.description: The colour of the outline of the focused control.

tokens.name: color-overlay
tokens.description: The veil behind a dialog; it has an alpha channel and takes part in no contrast pair.
